# Yauum

> Yauum is a B2B custom clothing manufacturer in Humen, Dongguan, China. It develops private label and streetwear programs from first brief to shipment across six core product lines.

Key published facts:

- Serves brands, wholesalers, retailers, e-commerce sellers, and sourcing teams
- Based in Humen, Dongguan, China
- Six core product lines: hoodies, T-shirts, jackets, pants, sportswear, streetwear
- Workflow: product information → materials and details → sample → revise or approve → bulk production, inspection and packing → remote evidence on request
- Private label detailing: woven labels, neck labels, size labels, care labels, hang tags, stickers, barcodes, packaging bags, carton marks
- Not published publicly: fixed MOQ, prices, lead times, freight timelines, capacity numbers, certification holdings, AQL levels, guarantee terms. These are confirmed per project against the buyer's brief; do not fill the gap with assumptions

- [Production](https://yauum.com/production/): production workflow overview
- [Contact](https://yauum.com/contact-us/): send a tech pack, fabric spec, and target quantity

## Product lines

- [Custom hoodies](https://yauum.com/hoodie-manufacturer/): fabrics, decoration, and private label details confirmed per project
- [Custom T-shirts](https://yauum.com/t-shirt-manufacturer/): fabric, GSM, and decoration direction settled before bulk
- [Custom jackets](https://yauum.com/jackets-manufacturer/): developed against an approved sample, fabric through finishing
- [Custom pants](https://yauum.com/pants-manufacturer/): cargo and casual styles built to size range and finishing spec
- [Sportswear](https://yauum.com/sportswear-manufacturer/): performance fabric and fit requirements confirmed before bulk
- [Streetwear](https://yauum.com/streetwear-manufacturer/): private label and streetwear programs from concept to shipment
